verdict.rationale: Grafana documents its own collection agent, Grafana Alloy, for shipping logs to Loki and Grafana Cloud. It also documents Kubernetes Monitoring, cloud-provider monitoring across AWS, Azure and GCP, and OpenTelemetry-based collection. However, the evidence does not show how Alloy or these integrations actually instrument each target, and hosts and containers are never explicitly covered. Missing for 10: explicit host/node and container instrumentation evidence, documentation of how Kubernetes and cloud integrations are deployed and collect data, Alloy coverage beyond logs, independent hands-on corroboration.
